description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for the wishlist screen in an e-commerce app. It builds a UI that displays products saved in the wishlist, handles loading and empty states, and allows toggling wishlist status and navigating to product details.

classes.name: WishlistScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget representing the wishlist page where users can view products they have added, see loading states, and navigate to product details.

methods.name: _productId
methods.description: Generates a unique string identifier for a product based on its brandName, title, and image.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, displaying loading indicator, empty message, or grid of product cards based on wishlist state.
